source.notes: arch-074 (flagship Nest combinator). Masked second-order UNNORMALIZED causal case (paper Eq. 3.3 + Algorithm 1, the default operator): S_t = Σk_ik_iᵀ, C_t = Σq_iv_iᵀ, G_t = G_{t-1} + ΔS_t·C_{t-1}, o_t = q_tᵀ(S_tC_t − G_t). The Nest shape is two dependent additive prefix accumulations with the strict-causality correction from the nesting; the per-token prefix matrices are the carried state bundle (the K2 read q_tᵀM_t does not expose the matrix, so the prefix scan + correction are the external Nest structure). Verified against the pinned paper (HLA.pdf, arXiv 2510.27258, @ 484fef2b). Layer module: architectures/hla.py.

params.combinator: Nest: two dependent additive prefix accumulations (S_t, C_t) + strict-causality correction (G_t)

coverage.notes: Serial-recurrence parity vs an independent brute-force transcription of the closed-form masked identity, the strict-causality gate (future-token perturbation does not change earlier outputs), and gradients through the nested recurrence in tests/test_architectures_hla.py. NOT claimed (sweep verdict): the normalized variant (Eq. 3.4, +ε), decay γ (Eq. 4.1), ridge λ, the chunk-parallel associative scan, and any source-derived VJP (autograd through the external recurrence covers backward).
